name: Apple Shortcuts Response
description: Receives and parses Apple Shortcuts JSON results sent over WebSocket by the Apple Shortcuts module

ok.description: Whether the last Apple Shortcuts action succeeded

action.description: Last Apple Shortcuts action executed (run, list)

shortcut.description: Name of the shortcut executed by the last run action

output.description: Plain-text output returned by the last run shortcut

count.description: Number of shortcuts returned by the last list action

error.description: Error message if the last Apple Shortcuts action failed

responseReceived.description: Triggered whenever a WebSocket response arrives from Apple Shortcuts
